responsibility: Primary implementation file for LoongArch code generation and target hooks. It owns the backend’s RTL expansion, address and symbol handling, constant materialization, prologue/epilogue and calling convention logic, register classes and mode legality, block move and atomic helpers, assembly printing, scheduling and cost hooks, section/output behavior, builtin hook registration, and the final TARGET_INITIALIZER wiring that connects the LoongArch target to GCC’s middle and back ends.
same_name_distinction: For the broader loongarch same-name set, this is the main C++ backend implementation file that realizes target hooks, RTL expansion, calling convention handling, assembly output, and targetm initialization. Unlike loongarch.h, loongarch.md, and loongarch.opt, it is imperative backend code rather than a macro header, machine-description file, or option-definition file.
